synthesis_input.objective: Synthesize a path-sensitive detector that encodes the patch-evidenced local state, guards, and lifecycle mechanism, while remaining open to the true vulnerability family being uncertain.

trigger_invariants: the vulnerable mechanism is reachable on a feasible path
the path lacks the barrier introduced by the patch
Patch-backed trigger clue: added guard: if ((iris_info.dimension == 0) || (iris_info.dimension > 3))
Patch-backed trigger clue: added or highlighted APIs: ThrowReaderException
silence_invariants: patch-introduced guards, barriers, or safe APIs must suppress findings
transfer_axes: only generalize along evidence-backed state, guard, flow, or API-role equivalence
forbidden_shortcuts: bind the detector to fixed file paths, line numbers, or exact patch strings
broaden into unrelated bug families just to improve hit count
use the patch text itself as the matching rule
widen to unrelated bug families without evidence
placeholder helper logic or empty ProgramState modeling

hypotheses: Patch likely encodes a reusable vulnerability mechanism but available metadata is weak; keep evidence collection broad.

semantic_clause_plan.intent: Trigger on the vulnerable unknown mechanism using evidence-backed path/flow semantics.
Stay silent on patched code when patch-added guards, barriers, or safe APIs prove the mechanism is blocked.
Generalize along semantic slices and call-chain evidence rather than patch-local syntax.
Preserve valid analyzer-facing syntax and interfaces while keeping semantics unchanged.

constraints.title: Generalize beyond patch site
constraints.description: Do not bind the detector to fixed file paths, line numbers, or exact patch strings.

constraints.title: Preserve vulnerability semantics
constraints.description: Keep the detector focused on the vulnerability family implied by the patch and evidence.

constraints.title: Respect analyzer-native form
constraints.description: Output must be a valid checker_plugin for csa.

constraints.title: Stay within proven mechanism scope
constraints.description: Generalize only along evidence-supported semantic dimensions. Do not broaden the detector into unrelated globals, APIs, or bug families.

constraints.title: Honor mechanism contract
constraints.description: Preserve the mechanism family `generic_vulnerability_mechanism` by keeping trigger invariants the vulnerable mechanism is reachable on a feasible path; the path lacks the barrier introduced by the patch; Patch-backed trigger clue: added guard: if ((iris_info.dimension == 0) || (iris_info.dimension > 3)).

constraints.title: Generalize only on contract axes
constraints.description: Reuse semantics only along these transfer axes: only generalize along evidence-backed state, guard, flow, or API-role equivalence.

constraints.title: Anchor on patch-touched scope
constraints.description: Use patch-touched files/functions as the semantic anchor for synthesis. Only extend beyond them when the same mechanism is explicitly supported by evidence.

constraints.title: Encode the patch-added barrier
constraints.description: treat guards such as if ((iris_info.dimension == 0) || (iris_info.dimension > 3)) as semantic barriers; use APIs such as ThrowReaderException as semantic clues, not string matches.

constraints.title: Respect patched silence
constraints.description: Use these no-report conditions when they are semantically proven: length/capacity guard present: if ((iris_info.dimension == 0) || (iris_info.dimension > 3)).

constraints.title: Use path-sensitive evidence
constraints.description: Prefer guards, state transitions, and lifecycle facts over broad textual matching.

constraints.title: No placeholder helper logic
constraints.description: Helper predicates must inspect AST/program state and must not be unconditional return-true/return-false stubs.

implementation_hints: Mechanism dimensions: vulnerability trigger, patch-introduced barrier, local state or flow relation

Silence invariants: patch-introduced guards, barriers, or safe APIs must suppress findings, length/capacity guard present: if ((iris_info.dimension == 0) || (iris_info.dimension > 3))

validation_expectations: Vulnerable version should trigger a unknown finding.

Repair phase may fix syntax/interfaces only; it must not simplify away the core detection logic.
Generalization must stay inside the mechanism contract transfer axes instead of widening to adjacent bug families.
